author: Sarah Nelson
title: Newest Feeding Our Future defendant quickly pleads guilty to fraud charge
notes: Contemporaneous court reporting from the July 30, 2026 plea proceeding. Use as secondary disposition evidence until the plea agreement/minute entry is captured. The article identifies Warsame's first name as Mahamoud.
supports: Mahamoud Warsame pleaded guilty in federal court in Minneapolis on July 30, 2026 to his Feeding Our Future wire-fraud charge.
Warsame admitted Metro Area Catering falsely claimed 1.6 million meals between February 2021 and January 2022 and that he used proceeds for personal purchases.
The article reports that the charging record states Warsame received more than $4.7 million in federal child-nutrition funds.
The article reports that the plea agreement requires forfeiture including a 2021 Mazda CX-3, a Plymouth home, and a Minneapolis commercial building.
The article identifies Warsame as the 80th person charged and states 69 defendants had been convicted as of publication.
does_not_support: The exact language of the plea agreement or judgment; those primary records are not reproduced here.
Treating the more-than-$4.7-million figure as proven loss rather than the amount described in the charging/plea reporting.
